title: Generalize bounded source-obligation/discharge authority from Foundation 1
description:
Generalize Foundation 1's independently source-anchored positive-obligation mechanism
for explicitly bounded populations. Obligation authority comes from an independent
source anchor, not the projection output or caller assertion it is meant to test.
This bead does not establish a global obligation registry, source census, clause
universe, discovery completeness, deterministic completeness, finding membership,
or evidence taxonomy.
acceptance_criteria:
- Authoritative obligations are independently source-anchored and not mutable through consumer references.
- Obligation identity is independent of generated record/atom identity and cannot collide with it.
- Discharge is injective and preserves required multiplicity, alternatives, branches, and conjunctive parts.
- Missing, duplicated, malformed, aliased, or unrecognized evidence cannot false-green a declared obligation.
- Known-missing projection is representable without treating unknown clauses as satisfied.
- Any bounded completeness claim identifies its independent source-derived population.
- Passing this mechanism proves only the declared bounded obligations, never corpus/source/discovery/deterministic completeness.
notes:
